baseline_weaknesses: Flat solid sky rectangles with no outdoor depth or atmosphere
Raw rectangular cliff blocks lacking organic contours and geological stratification
Crude 2D geometric bridge material squares lacking tactile affordance and material identity
Geometric procedural bunny circle with ear twitches instead of canonical Greia character companion
Missing bridge suspension cables, anchor piers, and tactile structural framing
Identical layout across levels differentiated only by backdrop color fills

traveler_character.rationale: Flash is Greia's canonical energetic bunny mascot, perfectly suited for bridge crossing, jumping, and trampoline rebound mechanics without inventing an uncoordinated mascot.

river_backdrop.rationale: Canonical generic library assets provide rich storybook meadow layers and lighting.

canyon_backdrop.derivation: Warm amber sky with atmospheric sunlight rays and layered polygonal sandstone mesas in background.
canyon_backdrop.rationale: Creates a distinct desert chasm environment while reusing canonical sky elements.

space_backdrop.derivation: Deep cosmic indigo sky with twinkling multi-point starfield, cratered celestial moon, and beacon-lit launch platforms.
space_backdrop.rationale: Unmistakably non-terrestrial cosmic setting without dense sci-fi UI clutter.

banks_and_cliffs.derivation: Authored SVG masters with rounded storybook grass/dirt layers, canyon strata with sandstone ledges, and space titanium hulls with cyan energy lines.
banks_and_cliffs.rationale: Provides tactile physical abutments for suspension bridge anchors across all 3 distinct worlds.

bridge_materials.rationale: The 4 materials (wood, stone, shroom, rainbow) are gameplay-critical tactile construction elements unique to Costruiamo Ponti requiring identical recognition in palette, empty slot hints, and placed bridge decks.

safety_trampoline.rationale: Friendly safety bounce net located in the gap to rebound Flash safely on structural failure.

goal_flag.rationale: Golden pennant and carrot reward marker on the right bank.

gameplay_and_navigation.rationale: All core puzzle logic, 4-material requirements, sound synthesis, event emission, storage persistence, and platform Home button integration preserved 100%.

compose_adapt_resources_and_derivations.source_language: Greia cosmic launch deck titanium platforms

traveler_character_decision.rationale: Flash brings dynamic personality to the crossing sequence with seamless support for neutral idle bounce, happy hopping across planks, and surprised expressions during trampoline bounces without creating a redundant ad-hoc character.

three_world_visual_strategy.river: Friendly natural meadow with distant hills, rippling blue river water, flowering bushes, and organic green turf banks.
three_world_visual_strategy.canyon: Warm amber canyon with layered mesa geology, terracotta chasm, and sandstone cliff ledges.
three_world_visual_strategy.space: Deep cosmic indigo sky, multi-point twinkling starfield, cratered celestial moon, and beacon-lit titanium launch decks.

runtime_architecture.image_loading: Package-contained build-time PNGs loaded on startup with fail-soft vector fallbacks
runtime_architecture.sandbox_compliance: Zero forbidden imports (no os/sys in activity package)
runtime_architecture.resolution_independence: PygameReferenceCanvas 1024x600 logical coordinate space with contained letterboxing/pillarboxing

focused_tests_and_results.coverage: Manifest interaction profile, reference canvas compliance, runtime asset existence, and bounded semantic geometry.

fault_injection_and_restoration.behavior: When decorative PNG assets are unavailable, activity gracefully falls back to clean procedural geometric renditions without crashing.

library_gap_analysis.rationale: Costruiamo Ponti successfully leveraged existing generic assets (Flash, hills, clouds, sunlight rays, bushes, rocks) and authored activity-specific bridge materials package-locally without requiring Generic Batch B.
